nodes.name: Upload Reused Video to Supabase Storage

parameters.text: Inspect the entire short AI-generated product video. Use the first sharp, unobstructed view of the sign as the baseline and compare the same sign parts throughout the video. Return ONLY one-line JSON, no markdown, using exactly: {"approved":true|false,"confidence":0.0,"issues":["code"],"evidence":[{"code":"code","timestamps":[0.0,0.0],"description":"specific visible change"}]}. Allowed issue codes: DESIGN_MORPH,COLOR_SHIFT,INVENTED_TEXT,INVENTED_OBJECT,UNWANTED_BRANDING,SIGN_DISAPPEARS,FLOATING_SIGN,BAD_CROP,OTHER. Every reported issue MUST have specific evidence. For DESIGN_MORPH or COLOR_SHIFT, evidence must identify the same changed sign part at two clear timestamps at least 1.0 second apart. Do not count normal camera motion, perspective change, apparent size change from a dolly or zoom, motion blur, compression, depth of field, reflections, shadows, or subtle glow/intensity changes as defects. Reject only for a clearly visible persistent defect: altered sign text, logo, symbol, proportions, layout, material, mounting or light color; invented content; disappearance; floating; or unusable crop. Do not reject merely because the camera moves or because you are uncertain. If no defect is clearly evidenced, set approved=true with empty issues and evidence. Set approved=false only when at least one issue has matching evidence. Confidence is certainty in the decision, not defect severity.
